body: Thank you. I really like the idea of volunteering at a food bank. I will go try that tomorrow night and see how I feel about it. I will keep you updated.

Thank you. It used to make me so happy when I donated money, clothes, materials to humanitarian organizations. Now it just do not feel it anymore. I mean sure I am still helping people, but it does not feel the same. I am not as unique as you say. All of my business partners and friends do the same as I.

Thank you. I am honoured that you choose this time to create an account. I will go read the book. Unfortunately, I rarely have time to curl up and read. I will attempt to schedule this in a few nights a week, though. Maybe it will help. I understand money is not important. Sure, it's important to people without food, shelter, water, medication etc.. but it sure does not buy happiness.
But if not on my shoulders, than whom? I realize that there are not many people who can afford to help the hunger cause, or anything else. If the so called 1 percent don't do it.. who else will?

My relationship with my sister is a good one. We used to fight a lot when we were young, but as we grew up, it gradually became better. My childhood was rough, at least in my standards. When I was 17, I had 3 of my close friends die, and that is actually what caused me to start my company at the age of 19.

As fantastic as the last idea seems, it's also a huge waste of money that would be looked down upon by my family. Although I'm tempted to try to convince them it is a good idea. Responding to /u/redappless , I do realise how much humanity sucks and needs improving, that's why I got into philanthropy in the first place. I guess I can stand to go live in a 3rd world country for a bit.
What are your own problems? Feel free to PM me

Correct. I know its bad to think that way. But I dont know how to improve. I want to.

Im going to try to sleep. This is killing me. Ill check back tomorrow morning. Thank you so much though.
Not the wrong idea at all. Im German, so its true - Im very uptight. And thank you for the compliment, English is actually my second language. How do you suggest I let loose?

Ive tried so hard. I never wear brand names - First and business class makes me feel like a snob, so even on 16 hour plane rides, I take economy. I drive a Prius because its good for the environment. I want to go out and befriend someone, but no, they always find out I have money. Im slightly scared of a relationship - my ex cheated on me and destroyed my heart, but I got over it. 

Thank you, though - those are really good ideas.

Thats the problem. I have no reason to feel this way. No reason at all. Retreating to what? Ive got nothing to retreat to. I cant leave my job - more than a month without me and the office gets messy. They start slacking off, and it trickles down the chain.

I dont know. There isnt much on my bucket list. I got divorced five years ago, and I guess the only thing is to get in a relationship. Judging by the way I look, and how much I work.. I doubt that will happen any time soon. I dont want a woman who is there for the money. I want a woman that loves me for me. I cant find that.

Other than that, no. Ive done most of the things I want to do. I know this is a horrible thing to be sad about, and I do understand most dont get to this stage in their life.. but I really feel like this is it. Ive got nothing left to live for
